label: CER eCTD 4.0 — Literature Analysis
description: Systematic literature review and data analysis for VenaGuard™ IVC Filter CER.

inputs.device_name: VenaGuard™ Retrievable Inferior Vena Cava (IVC) Filter
inputs.databases_searched: PubMed/MEDLINE (n=1,847 hits), Embase (n=2,104 hits), Cochrane Library (n=312 hits), WHO ICTRP (n=89 hits), clinicaltrials.gov (n=64 registered studies)
inputs.included_in_analysis: 83 (47 for subject device family, 36 for equivalent device family)
inputs.prisma_note: PRISMA 2020 flow diagram included in CER Appendix A. Full search strings documented in Appendix B.
inputs.study_type_breakdown: Randomized controlled trials: 4; Prospective cohort studies: 18; Retrospective cohort studies: 31; Registry analyses: 12; Systematic reviews/meta-analyses: 8; Case series (≥20 pts): 10
inputs.total_patients_subject: 3,412 patients across 47 publications (VenaGuard™ and predecessor VenaGuard Classic)
inputs.total_patients_equivalent: 8,940 patients across 36 publications (Bard G2/G2 Express family)
inputs.appraisal_criteria: Modified OCEBM levels; GRADE approach applied to key outcomes. Two independent reviewers with third-party adjudication for discrepancies. Inter-rater agreement (Cohen's kappa): 0.87.
inputs.key_outcome_1_conclusion: Equivalent. No clinically meaningful difference in deployment success.
inputs.key_outcome_2_conclusion: Equivalent or superior. Point estimate favors VenaGuard™.
inputs.key_outcome_3_conclusion: Superior. Statistically significant improvement in retrieval rate (p<0.001).
inputs.key_outcome_4_conclusion: Equivalent or superior. Lower migration rate may be attributable to strut design optimization.
inputs.key_outcome_5_name: IVC penetration (strut perforation through caval wall)
inputs.key_outcome_5_conclusion: Equivalent. IVC penetration rates consistent with known class effect of conical IVC filters.
inputs.key_outcome_6_conclusion: Superior. Significant reduction in fracture rate attributed to optimized nitinol fatigue life.
inputs.safety_summary: The literature analysis demonstrates that VenaGuard™ has a safety profile equivalent to or better than the predicate Bard G2 Express across all evaluated endpoints. No new or unexpected safety signals were identified. The most common adverse events (IVC penetration, filter tilt) are known class effects with low clinical significance.
inputs.performance_summary: VenaGuard™ meets or exceeds the clinical performance of the equivalent device family. Key advantages include higher retrieval success rate (96.8% vs 92.3%) and lower fracture rate (0.3% vs 2.1%). PE prevention efficacy is clinically equivalent.
inputs.data_gaps: Limited long-term (>5 year) data for permanent implantation; limited data in pediatric/adolescent populations; no head-to-head RCT against G2 Express; limited data on use during pregnancy.
inputs.grade_certainty: Moderate certainty for all primary outcomes (downgraded from high due to absence of head-to-head RCT).
